desc: Derive and implement forced-character propagation for all `T` windows, detecting overlaps and conflicts.
Prove the left-to-right greedy completion rule and identify exactly which `F` windows impose a constraint when their final position is assigned.
Implement tracking/checking of `F` windows, including multiple windows ending at one position and forced-character mismatches.
Validate edge cases: `m=1`, overlapping `T` windows, adjacent `F` windows, and impossible forced matches.
Produce the final `Solution.generateString` code with complexity analysis for `n <= 10^4`, `m <= 500`.
